name: People and Partners
purpose: Leadership, teams, collaborators, client rosters and ecosystem stories.
existingKitCaveat: These are working starting points, not exact implementations of the reference geometry.
identityRules: Keep portraits equal in frame size, crop scale and caption baseline.
Place index numbers beside names rather than over portraits.
Set partner marks in a staggered field with generous gaps.

typography.sourceAdjustment: Reference body sizes scaled from 1920px often fall below the engine's 14pt export floor. Raise body text to at least 24 engine units and shorten or split copy; do not preserve an unreadable exact ratio.

whitespace.policy: Reference negative-space zones are reserved. Do not introduce text, photos or charts into those zones; full-bleed backgrounds may cross them.
whitespace.referenceFrameCaveat: The common content frame applies to inset copy. Bleeding photographs and intentionally off-canvas elements follow their own pattern bounds.

variationRecipes: Alternate team slides with a quote or partner field.
Use three larger portraits for a small leadership team, keeping equal gutters.
Rebalance logo row centers according to each mark's visual width.
antiPatterns: Inventing missing people or partner affiliations.
Adding identical cards around every person or logo.

contentRules.photoQueries: Use distinct domain-specific queries; keep imagery dynamic.
contentRules.overflow: Shorten text or split slides before reducing font size or occupying whitespace.

readiness.newKitStatus: Registered; opt in through sequenceId or explicit variantHint. Existing default pools are unchanged.
